h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תֵצֵא, י״ג Ki Seitzei, 13
Shabbos Song Joins Wisdom Faith and Thanksgiving

p: "A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day" (Tehillim 92:1).
it counts the ten kinds of song
and says: "Shir — this is Chochmah," etc.
"And at night His song is with me"
about one who occupies himself with Torah at night
"'And now write for yourselves this song'" (Devarim 31:19),
that it is a mitzvah to write a Sefer Torah.
And Torah is the aspect of Chochmah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג פא, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (III 81a):
"There is no Torah without Chochmah, etc.,
and all is on one level."
and this is the right arm";
that is, Chesed is the right arm,
and Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for this attribute.
And so Chochmah, which is Torah, is light;
"'Let there be light' — this is Avraham,"
the two thousand years of Torah;
וְכֵן אִיתָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
"And the supernal Chesed issues from Chochmah."
And therefore the second meal of Shabbos,
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him
and likewise the prayers of Shabbos
are like the holiness of the meals
therefore in this prayer we say
"A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day,"
which correspond to the attributes of Chochmah and Chesed.
"It is good to give thanks to Hashem";
for it counts in the Tikkunim mentioned above:
And in this prayer we say
for it is in the secret of Daas;
therefore we mention an expression of thanksgiving,
"It is good to give thanks to Hashem,"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב נד, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 54a):
"And Alef bored through in the darkness,
and shone to every side, etc.,
which is the intellect hidden from all thought,
which is the seven lower attributes,
down to the attribute of Malchus.
(and as has been explained many times).
all the attributes up to Keser Elyon
is a chariot for the attribute of Hod,
and through it he merited to attain
up to the attribute of Keser Elyon,
which is the whole of the Name Havayah,
"And to sing to Your Name, O Most High":
and says "to Your Name, O Most High."
For Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
after he merited the attribute of old age,
"And Avraham was old, coming into days"
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קכט, א)
and it says in the holy Zohar (I 129a):
that is, that he merited to be refined
up to the aspect of Keser Elyon,
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א ריט, א)
and it says in the holy Zohar (I 219a):
"He gave a daughter to Avraham," etc.;
and Bakol was her name" (Bava Basra 16b).
to be refined in all ten attributes,
אֲבָל רַק עַל יְדֵי מִדַּת אֱמוּנָה
but only through the attribute of faith,
I did not make Myself known to them";
for although we find many times
that He spoke with the Avos
מִכָּל מָקוֹם לֹא הִשִּׂיגוּ זֶה הַשֵּׁם
nevertheless they did not attain this Name
but only through the aspect of faith.
that there is an intellect hidden from all thought;
and this is the secret of
"and to sing to Your Name, O Most High,"
אֲבָל רַק עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת אֱמוּנָה
but only through the aspect of faith,
which is the aspect of the Name Havayah
the Name Havayah in the secret of Daas.
And about this it is written:
"It is good to give thanks to Hashem";
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion."
in the psalm of this prayer
"To declare Your kindness in the morning":
that is, in the World to Come,
when it will be manifest to the eye;
"to declare Your kindness in the morning";
that everything is from Hashem's kindness.
and "great" with regard to Hashem Yisbarach
"For My thoughts are not your thoughts."
a boor is one empty of wisdom,
"and a fool does not understand this":
one in whom there is no fear of Heaven,
לָמָּה זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד כְּסִיל וְגוֹ׳
"Why is there a price in the hand of a fool," etc.,
that it is manifest to the eye,
as though pointing at it with a finger,
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
in the manner of what they said (Zohar III 230a):
"He is truth and He is faith";
that it be as manifest before the eye
But one who is a fool,
who has no fear of Heaven,
and he is "when the wicked bloom
which is only "that they be destroyed forever."
"The righteous man shall flourish like a palm tree," etc.,
'Fortunate is the man who does this.'"
For on Shabbos all of Yisrael merit
and one believes that all the exiles
are only so that there be
"the righteous man shall flourish like a palm tree,
planted in the house of Hashem," etc.;
and Yisrael have rest in the heart
in the midst of the hard labor;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנִּדְרָשׁ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פט, א)
as is expounded in the holy Zohar (II 89a):
"'On the day that Hashem gives you rest,' etc." (Yeshayahu 14:3)
rest in the heart of all Yisrael,
who see that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
and He looks only toward the good.
